publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS26mci (AT2026aeiv) in galaxy NGC 1184 at magnitude m_w = 19.08 +/- 0.11. At a distance of 34 Mpc, the transient was discovered on MJD = 61318.11 (2026-10-05.11) with an absolute magnitude of M = -14.2 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection (to 5 sigma, unforced) was on MJD = 61317.48. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
